Certificate.description:
The optimality certificate of one solved programme, computed from its primal and dual
values without trusting the solver's status. primal, dual_sign, stationarity and
duality_gap are unitless ratios: each is the largest violation in units of its tolerance,
so at most 1 passes and 1.0 is exactly at the tolerance.

dual_objective.description: Objective value of the dual solution (same units).
dual_objective.title: Dual Objective

dual_sign.description: Largest dual multiplier of the wrong sign, in units of its tolerance (1e-9 x max(1, the largest absolute objective coefficient)); at most 1 passes.
dual_sign.title: Dual Sign

duality_gap.description: |primal_objective - dual_objective| in units of its tolerance (1e-9 x max(1, the sum of the absolute objective terms)); at most 1 passes. A unitless ratio, not the absolute gap, which is the difference of the two objectives.
duality_gap.title: Duality Gap

holds.description: True when the four ratios are finite and at most 1: the solution is optimal within the tolerances (1e-7 absolute, 1e-9 relative).
holds.title: Holds

primal.description: Largest violation of a constraint row or variable bound, in units of its tolerance (1e-7 + 1e-9 x the magnitude of the row or bound); at most 1 passes.
primal.title: Primal

primal_objective.description: Objective value of the solution in the units of the programme's objective, its constant included.
primal_objective.title: Primal Objective

stationarity.description: Largest reduced-cost residual, in units of its tolerance (1e-9 x max(1, the magnitude of its terms)); at most 1 passes.
stationarity.title: Stationarity

info.description:
Read-only access to the ATLAS NYC 311 demand-forecasting research outputs (M2 forecasts,
M3 uncertainty, M4 decision simulation) and bounded HYPOTHETICAL simulations with the M4
linear-programming engine.

**Read before using any number.**

* Every response states what its numbers are (`integrity.data_status`): observed history,
  a projection, a historical evaluation, or a HYPOTHETICAL simulation.
* The projection is an archived projection issued from the frozen snapshot. It is not a
  live forecast, and it has never been scored: no outcome after the snapshot's last
  observed day is in the snapshot.
* The point forecast is not prospectively validated (`point_forecast_validated: false`).
* The M3 prediction intervals have the status **failed_calibration**: no interval or
  probability is decision-grade, and none is presented as one.
* Every M4 operational parameter is **HYPOTHETICAL**. Nothing returned is a validated
  staffing, budget or service-capacity recommendation (`validated_recommendation: false`
  is fixed by the schema).

Errors share one body: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}`.
info.title: ATLAS API

post.description:
Plan one HYPOTHETICAL city-wide unit over 1-30 days of the M2 projection with the M4
linear programme (certified optimum, tie-broken plan, uniqueness test, infeasibility
diagnosis, both baseline policies). Inputs are bounded (GET .../parameters); the result
is deterministic for equal inputs (``simulation_id``). Shadow-price brackets,
frontiers and sweeps are research analyses: they are served precomputed for the
reference scenarios and never run on request. The compute time is in the
``Server-Timing`` header.
